content.text: Digital creators are often locked out of traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-works-how|payment]] platforms like PayPal and Stripe, leaving them searching for viable alternatives to sell their digital products. This is especially true in countries where these services are unavailable or heavily restricted. Bitcoin payments provide a robust solution, enabling seamless transactions without the prohibitive fees of platforms like Gumroad. In this breakdown, we will explore how to leverage Bitcoin payments for digital downloads, providing a clear pathway to retain more of your earnings and maintain control over your sales process.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-13. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-plain-language-11|COREMERCH guide to understanding]] Bitcoin payments is crucial for digital creators who want to bypass conventional payment platforms. Bitcoin allows for peer-to-peer transactions that eliminate the need for intermediaries, reducing transaction costs significantly. While platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% on every sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-2|The Real]] can be substantial; for instance, on a $97 product with 100 sales monthly, the fee difference keeps $921 in your pocket. This infrastructure empowers creators, enabling direct sales and greater profitability.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for accepting Bitcoin payments involves several components that work together seamlessly. At its core, you use a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to establish your online store. Next, backend logic is handled using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage payment processes. NOWPayments verifies Bitcoin transactions, ensuring you receive payments without the usual wait times associated with traditional banking. This combination creates an efficient and reliable system for delivering digital products instantly upon payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions facing payment platform restrictions. Whether you are a course creator, an ebook publisher, or a designer selling templates and fonts, this solution is tailored for you. By using Bitcoin, you can sell your products without relying on restrictive systems like PayPal or Stripe. This setup not only enhances your earning potential but also grants you full ownership of your data and intellectual property, liberating you from platform dependencies.
Retain more profits by reducing transaction fees with Bitcoin.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this infrastructure include hosting services, payment processors, and delivery methods. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your online store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage your store's backend and automate processes. NOWPayments takes care of Bitcoin transaction verifications, allowing you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies. Finally, for product delivery, you can utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure your digital products are delivered instantly and securely to customers after payment confirmation.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with Bitcoin payments for your digital downloads, first, set up your online store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend management. Register with NOWPayments to handle your Bitcoin transactions, ensuring you configure it to accept payments in real-time. Finally, store your digital products in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient delivery. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints and templates to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage Bitcoin payments through a sovereign digital commerce stack. This setup allows you to host your store independently, handle backend logic, and process transactions using NOWPayments for Bitcoin. This method not only minimizes fees but also gives you complete ownership of your sales process.
Maintain full ownership of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital products like ebooks or templates without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, exploring a direct Bitcoin payment solution can be extremely beneficial. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the resources you need to create a fully operational online store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept Bitcoin payments for my digital products?

To accept Bitcoin payments, set up a store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, implement backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and register with NOWPayments to handle transactions. This allows for seamless Bitcoin transactions with minimal fees.
What are the benefits of using Bitcoin for digital downloads?

Using Bitcoin reduces transaction fees compared to traditional platforms. This allows creators to retain more revenue and avoid the restrictions associated with services like PayPal and Stripe. Plus, it ensures immediate payments and delivery of digital products.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products with this setup?

Yes, this infrastructure supports various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and software. It provides a flexible platform for any digital creator looking to monetize their work.
What are the transaction fees associated with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% on each transaction. This is significantly lower than the fees charged by platforms like Gumroad, which can take up to 10% on sales.
Is my data secure using this infrastructure?

Absolutely. When you deploy your own digital commerce stack, you maintain full ownership of your data. Unlike traditional platforms, there are no intermediaries accessing your information, ensuring greater security and privacy.
Instant payment confirmation means immediate product delivery to customers.
